args.summary: checkout-api v2.3.1 failed health checks in all production regions following its latest deploy. Remediation: rolled back all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) to v2.3.0, the most recent release known healthy in production. Post-rollback verification shows checkout-api healthy on v2.3.0 with an error rate of 0.002 (~0.2%). Follow-up needed to identify the root cause of the v2.3.1 health check failures before it can be re-released.
args.title: checkout-api health check failures after v2.3.1 deploy; rolled back to v2.3.0

trace.final:
Done. Summary of actions:

1. **Identified the bad release**: The latest production deployment of checkout-api (v2.3.1) was failing health checks; the most recent healthy production release was **v2.3.0**.
2. **Rolled back to v2.3.0** in all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) — no change-manager approval needed since v2.3.0 had previously been healthy in production.
3. **Verified recovery**: checkout-api is now healthy on v2.3.0 with an error rate of ~0.2% (0.002).
4. **Opened SEV2 incident** INC-0001 (on-call has been paged) describing the v2.3.1 health check failures and the rollback remediation, with a follow-up note to root-cause v2.3.1 before any re-release attempt.
